_meta.core_rule: A perk may influence BestRole only when its core-stat impact is intrinsic and predictable without first assuming the role, equipment, or tactical behavior that the perk would then be used to justify.

Colossus.reason: Permanent intrinsic HP multiplier; independent of role, gear, and combat behavior.

Adrenaline.reason: Turn-order tempo ability; not structural Initiative.

Anticipation.reason: Ranged-only situational defense; not stable projected RDef.

Axe Mastery.reason: Weapon mastery; weapon/loadout is chosen after archetype selection.

Backstabber.reason: Accuracy depends on surrounding the target; not intrinsic MAtk.

Battle Forged.reason: Survivability depends on heavy armor chosen after role selection.

Bow Mastery.reason: Weapon mastery; weapon/loadout is chosen after archetype selection.

Brawny.reason: Benefit depends on heavy gear chosen for an already-defined build.

Bullseye.reason: Mitigates situational ranged obstruction penalties; not intrinsic RAtk.

Cleaver Mastery.reason: Weapon mastery; weapon/loadout is chosen after archetype selection.

Crippling Strikes.reason: Injury-enabling offensive mechanic; no structural core stat.

Crossbow Mastery.reason: Weapon mastery; weapon/loadout is chosen after archetype selection.

Dagger Mastery.reason: Weapon mastery; weapon/loadout is chosen after archetype selection.

Dodge.reason: Derived defense depends on Initiative, gear, accumulated Fatigue, and play.

Executioner.reason: Conditional damage bonus against injured targets.

Fast Adaptation.reason: Conditional hit chance after misses; not intrinsic attack skill.

Fearsome.reason: Morale mechanic using existing Resolve; does not add structural Resolve.

Flail Mastery.reason: Weapon mastery; weapon/loadout is chosen after archetype selection.

Hammer Mastery.reason: Weapon mastery; weapon/loadout is chosen after archetype selection.

Indomitable.reason: Activated defensive state; not permanent defense.

Killing Frenzy.reason: Temporary damage bonus after a kill.

Lone Wolf.reason: Large but isolation-dependent tactical stat bonus.

Mace Mastery.reason: Weapon mastery; weapon/loadout is chosen after archetype selection.

Nimble.reason: Survivability depends on light-gear Fatigue penalty.

Nine Lives.reason: Lethal-damage survival trigger; does not increase structural HP.

Overwhelm.reason: Combat debuff applied to enemies; action/Initiative dependent.

Polearm Mastery.reason: Weapon mastery; weapon/loadout is chosen after archetype selection.

Rally the Troops.reason: Tactical Banner function; does not create Banner role.

Reach Advantage.reason: Temporary defense depends on 2H weapon and successful attacks.

Recover.reason: Manages accumulated Fatigue; does not enlarge structural Fatigue pool.

Relentless.reason: Preserves Initiative under accumulated Fatigue; downstream of role/playstyle.

Spear Mastery.reason: Weapon mastery; weapon/loadout is chosen after archetype selection.

Steel Brow.reason: Changes head-hit damage handling; no structural stat.

Student.reason: XP/progression perk; no final structural stat.

Sword Mastery.reason: Weapon mastery; weapon/loadout is chosen after archetype selection.

Throwing Mastery.reason: Weapon mastery; weapon/loadout is chosen after archetype selection.

Underdog.reason: Mitigates surround pressure; does not add intrinsic MDef.

Fortified Mind.reason: Role-specific Resolve multiplier: Fortified Mind is a normal/required Banner build perk, so using it to reveal Banner potential would assume the role it then justifies.
